description: This file defines configuration structures, options, and functions for creating and customizing resource objects in the OpenTelemetry SDK, including detectors for environment, host, OS, process, and container attributes.

classes.name: config
classes.description: Configuration structure for resource creation, holding detectors and schema URL.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Interface for configuration options that modify resource creation.

classes.name: detectAttributes
classes.description: Struct for holding attribute key-value pairs for detection.

classes.name: detectorsOption
classes.description: Struct for holding a list of detectors to be applied.

classes.name: schemaURLOption
classes.description: Type for schema URL option with apply method.

methods.name: Detect
methods.description: Detects resource attributes based on context and stored attributes.
